scope: React state, server data preparation and frontend comment policies

reviewPasses.decision: Source semantics and preset integration belong in code-standards.
Separate saved language preparation from the reactive union with pending edits.
Retain saved revisions, pending operations and conflicts when their setters are observed.
Reuse react-hooks/set-state-in-effect rather than add an overlapping detector.
Reuse no-client-side-data-fetching and prefer-server-actions for existing request boundaries.
Reuse no-unnecessary-use-client for components without client behavior.
Leave unread values to unused-variable checks; inspect values actually consumed by a view.
The upstream unused-state rule targets unread state, rather than read-only mirrored props.
A prop copied into state can retain its first render value when props change.
Keep the new check advisory and preserve mount-time snapshots through manual review.
Distinguish an executed function argument from an explicit lazy callback returning a prop as data.
Require native non-callable type information for eager initializers; exclude callable unions, legacy function-like types and unknown types.
Resolve React imports through lexical bindings, including aliases and namespaces.
Exclude foreign, type-only, shadowed and import-equals bindings.
Support direct value/updater tuples and omitted or hole updaters; preserve escaping tuples.
An updater read or escape preserves independently editable state.
A type query does not constitute a runtime state update.
Resolve direct first-parameter paths without guessing from variable names.
Abstain when parameters, state bindings or updater bindings are reassigned.
Recognize synchronous zero-argument callbacks returning a direct prop path.
Preserve calls, browser snapshots, async initialization and additional statements.
Unwrap TypeScript expression wrappers without treating an assertion as runtime proof.
Exclude optional and computed dynamic paths and unproved aliases.
Require the containing function to contain its own JSX; exclude nested handlers and effects.
Exclude generated sources and tests from the state and preparation advisories.
Restrict preparation advisories to data-only inputs in independently interactive views; preserve inputs needed for editing and other domain work.
Require a genuine directive prologue, not a later string expression.
Require native Array or ReadonlyArray method declarations; exclude custom collections and missing type services.
Support fixed field and data-object projections with callbacks reading their own parameter.
Support simple fixed predicates, conditionals and operators without captured values.
Preserve filtering that captures search, selection, form state or another prop.
Exclude browser calls and opaque formatter/helper calls.
Keep element construction and presentation mapping in the view.
Exclude handlers, effects, memo callbacks and async or multi-statement projections.
Preserve aliased, dynamic, optional and mutating collection operations.
Bound supported parameter shapes and reject this-arguments, index parameters and opaque callbacks.
Allow review of a saved subprojection while pending edits remain reactive.
Report the direct source projection once instead of every call in a chain.
Provide no automatic state or server-boundary rewrite; verify convergence and explicit suppressions.
Bound path/type inspection and cache JSX ownership for immutable AST nodes.
Retain coverage of line, block, JSDoc and JSX comments; preserve strings and rendered text.
Cover JSX sources, framework imports/directives and frontend package helpers.
Keep frontend-test comment ownership in no-test-comments without duplicate findings.
Report frontend directives and legal notices while keeping substantive removal manual.
Promote the previously published frontend and test comment policies to error; exercise both presets.
Create and prepare both new rules through the native lifecycle CLI and synchronize metadata.
Reuse the upstream transactional capture fix and extend native generated-declaration write and rollback coverage.
Avoid an existing local candidate version and preserve immutable published versions.
Use immutable private corpora and repeated cold/warm workers; reject parser failures instead of counting them as clean results.
Run the complete native make verify gate with pinned tools and isolated temporary fixtures.

verification.qualificationPolicy: Local make verify failures remain recorded. Repaired checks passed complete changed-file preflight; final repository qualification uses normal native Git hooks and canonical CI. No failed command is relabeled as passed.
verification.postCommitQualification: Normal native commit/push hooks and the canonical exact-head CI aggregate/artifact proof are tracked on the pull request, without rewriting this audit receipt after commit.

labeledFixtures.interpretation: Hand-labeled unit fixtures establish supported boundaries; these counts do not estimate fleet accuracy.

privateCorpus.method: Native run_isolated_corpora API, frozen private source, alternating baseline/candidate order. Baseline enables the existing client-fetch and unnecessary-client-boundary owners; candidate additionally enables both new rules. Every new finding was inspected with its producer.
privateCorpus.performanceLimits: Measurements include one cold and two warm lint loops per fresh worker on a shared host, with the same compiled plugin loaded in both modes. Compiler program construction precedes lint timing; peak RSS includes it. These observations are neither a startup comparison nor a fleet cost bound, and noisy timing differences do not establish a speedup.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Relative paths were resolved against the nested TypeScript configuration directory. Every sample failed parser binding. These workers provide no detector or performance qualification.
A broad detector produced four false positives in an editing workflow among five inspected warnings. Narrowed eligibility to data-only inputs and independent client behavior.

limitations: The state check remains advisory because initial snapshots may be intentional. Eager copies need usable native type information.
The preparation check cannot prove that a producer is a Server Component or that moving data improves end-to-end cost. Reactive inputs must remain reactive.
Corpus zeroes are unlabeled and are not counted as true negatives. Native type/profile gaps must be disclosed.
Public results contain aggregate evidence only; private source, paths and identifying hashes remain in owner-readable receipts.
Publication and consumer adoption remain separate from implementation and local qualification.
method: 50 distinct source, ownership and semantic-boundary review passes. These are not 50 new rules or 50 identical executions. Canonical regression qualification is recorded separately.
